## Description

Compute per-draft edit distance + clinician rating ("minor edits?") to report the share signed with only minor edits; run a clinician trust survey; compare time-to-signed-note against the P2 manual baseline (target −40 %).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Dashboard shows % drafts signed with minor edits per clinician and overall (target ≥ 80 %).
- [ ] **AC2.** Trust survey completed by all opt-in clinicians; results summarised.
- [ ] **AC3.** Time to signed note compared with the P2 baseline with method stated.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
